name: @ionity/ewp

author: Johan Wilhelm van Antwerp | Ionity (Pty) Ltd | Ionity Global (Pty) Ltd

scripts.check:c: printf '#include "ewp_protocol.h"\nint main(void){return EWP_HEADER_LEN==16?0:1;}\n' > generated/.check.c && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Igenerated -fsyntax-only generated/.check.c && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Igenerated -fsyntax-only -x c++ generated/.check.c && rm generated/.check.c
